# watchpoint_dashboard (Data Source)

Looks up a single analytics dashboard by name within the tenant. Returns the scalar dashboard fields only; the widget layout is not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_dashboard" "example" {
  name = "Service Overview"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the dashboard to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) Dashboard ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's default dashboard.
